transcription.text: Hey everyone my name is Brady. I just wanted to give a quick shout out to Stone Systems.
They've helped my business a ton. I run a door-to-door roofing company and they helped
build me an amazing website and get me out on the map. Hopefully over the next couple
months, I'll be top three in Google and I can start getting some leads by not having
to pound the pavement. But I can't recommend Sebastian enough over there at Stone Systems.
He's answered all my questions in a super timely manner, as well as, you know, any questions
or concerns that I do have. I just reach out to him and I get a reply typically to him
like an hour, which is awesome. So 10 hours then.
